name: Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity
storyline:
If this urban legend is true, someone must step forward to put a stop to it.

But I am just an ordinary sixth-former; I simply do not possess that sort of power.

So, in order to confirm whether this urban legend is true or false, I tried cursing myself using several different rituals.

Regrettably, I cannot be certain which ritual was the correct one, but the night before last, Aya appeared in my dream.

If I, too, meet a mysterious death tonight, it will mean that the urban legend of the ‘Cursed Doll Aya’ is indeed true.

When that time comes…

When that time comes, I beg you—whoever you may be.

Please unravel the mystery of this urban legend.
summary: "Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity" is a Time-loop horror RTA stealth action adventure Game, Seira steps into the school at midnight to which seven mysteries and the brutal curse of the cursed doll, Aya await her there, Break free from this inescapable loop of death and escape this night of terror.
